# Web performance

Use when pages feel slow or Core Web Vitals regress.

## Measure first
1. Check field data (CrUX, RUM) for LCP, INP and CLS at the 75th percentile, by page type and device.
2. Reproduce in a lab run (Lighthouse, WebPageTest) with mobile throttling, and record the baseline.

## LCP (loading)
- Find the LCP element. Make it discoverable in the HTML (no client-side rendering for it, no lazy-loading).
- Serve images in modern formats at the right size with `srcset`; preload or set `fetchpriority="high"` on the hero.
- Cut server response time: caching, CDN, streaming.

## INP (responsiveness)
- Find long tasks in the performance panel. Split work, defer non-urgent work, and move heavy computation off the main thread.
- Reduce JavaScript: code-split routes, remove unused dependencies, and check bundle analyzers.

## CLS (stability)
Reserve space for images, ads and embeds with width/height or `aspect-ratio`. Avoid inserting content above existing content, and use `font-display` with metric-matched fallbacks.

## Guard
Add a bundle-size budget and a Lighthouse CI check, so regressions fail the build.

## Verify
Before and after numbers from the same lab setup, then confirm in field data after release.
